_source: Authored synthetic regression script. It is not a transcript reconstruction and makes no claim about production wording or turn order.
messages: I think tide-pool animals hide more when the water gets warmer.
Could I test that without moving the animals?
I would count how many are visible at the same rocks before and after noon.
But the tide height changes too, so that might confuse the result.
Maybe I could compare two pools at the same time instead.
What should I record besides temperature?
I do not know how many days would be enough.
If my counts disagree with my guess, I would want to know what else changed.
